name: Securities Order Status
definition: Status of a securities order or of the processing of a securities order.

ConfirmationRejectedStatusReason.name: Confirmation Rejected Status Reason
ConfirmationRejectedStatusReason.definition: Specifies the reason for a confirmation rejected status.

ConfirmationStatus.name: Confirmation Status
ConfirmationStatus.definition: Status of the confirmation of a status order.

CancellationStatus.name: Cancellation Status
CancellationStatus.definition: Status of the cancellation of a securities order.

PartiallySettledStatusReason.name: Partially Settled Status Reason
PartiallySettledStatusReason.definition: Reason for the partially settled status.

ListOrderStatus.name: List Order Status
ListOrderStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a list order.

ConditionallyAcceptedStatus.name: Conditionally Accepted Status
ConditionallyAcceptedStatus.definition: Reason for the conditionally accepted status.

OrderStatus.name: Order Status
OrderStatus.definition: Indicates the status of an order at a specific point in time.

SecuritiesOrder.name: Securities Order
SecuritiesOrder.definition: Order for which a status is specified.

InvestmentFundOrder.name: Investment Fund Order
InvestmentFundOrder.definition: Investment fund order for which a status is provided.

CumulativeQuantity.name: Cumulative Quantity
CumulativeQuantity.definition: Total quantity (for instance number of shares) filled.
